messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate"
set: ["take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "sucralfate", "2 hours", "avoid alcohol within 2 hours before or after taking extended-release carvedilol (Coreg CR)", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "around 2 hours", "take 4 to 6 hours after resin", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "8 mg orally 1 to 2 hours before radiotherapy", "2 to 3 hours", "avoid taking within 4 hours before or after use of certain drugs"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
